PainterlyNPR__ContextMenu__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: The app's own right-click menu, in place of the browser's: when a right press counts as a click, and how the menu sits on the page.

PainterlyNPR__ContextMenu__Config__Menu.Note: The right button pans the sheet: a right press that moved further than SlopPx was a pan, and opens no menu at its end. Text fields keep the browser's own menu, for copy and paste.
PainterlyNPR__ContextMenu__Config__Menu.SlopPxNote: A touch more than the navigation's 3 px, so a press the navigation took for a click is a click here too
PainterlyNPR__ContextMenu__Config__Menu.MouseWindowMsNote: A menu event this soon after a right release is the mouse's; later, the keyboard's (the menu key or Shift + F10), opened at the focused element
PainterlyNPR__ContextMenu__Config__Menu.EdgePxNote: The menu keeps this far inside the window, flipping to the other side of the pointer when it would not fit
PainterlyNPR__ContextMenu__Config__Menu.MaxHeightPxNote: A placed asset's whole menu fits; a longer one (the materials) scrolls. Never taller than the window
PainterlyNPR__ContextMenu__Config__Menu.SubmenuDelayMsNote: Hovering an item with more opens its submenu after this long, so a pointer crossing the menu does not open every one it passes
